evidence: Two real Better Auth sessions see the same canonical UUID and team issue number after accept and assignment.
The issue leaves pending triage and appears in team work with matching server-attributed history.
Valid source references survive accept and decline.
Incoming creation is canonical and visible after another account reloads.
Competing accept and decline requests on the same revision commit one decision, one decision event and one audit record.
The losing client shows the conflict and retained decision draft.
A losing decision cannot rebase after the issue leaves triage.
Uncertain response retries retain the original command identity and reviewed revision.
Injected audit failure rolls back issue state, history, receipt and outbox together.
Live private-team access, assignee eligibility and revocation apply to commands and replays.
